findings.evidence: pipeline load/clamp/save_progress has no file locking; concurrent companion runs can overwrite the shared progress.json cursor.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/pipeline.py:277-285 — Concurrent progress race. Operators running companion concurrently are hurt: runs can overwrite the shared progress cursor, causing chapters to be reprocessed or progress warnings to be missed.

findings.evidence: _unstructured_consistency_finding uses severity=neutral and summary 'Consistency check completed (unstructured response)', so a non-dict JSON array is surfaced as a benign completed finding rather than a parse failure.
findings.message: ghostreader/agents/consistency_checker.py:175 — Neutral fallback misclassification. Users can see a benign-looking “completed” finding when a non-empty response contains no usable dict items, obscuring that the consistency result was unstructured.

findings.evidence: thrash_export.analyze_thrash_findings calls detect_common_word_thrash without load_bearing, so LOAD_BEARING_* thresholds never apply on the analyze product path.
findings.message: ghostreader/analyzers/common_word_thrash.py:275 — Common-word coverage and threshold mismatch. Authors can miss carpet findings for frequent body words, and load-bearing words are judged with the ordinary threshold because the export caller supplies no load-bearing set.

findings.evidence: _QUOTE_RE + attribute_quotes treat any same-line quotes near a name as dialogue; reproduced narration 'dead silence' attributed to Mara (batch line 300 is a weak anchor).
findings.message: ghostreader/analyzers/voice_card_detector.py:39 — Narration treated as dialogue. Authors are hurt: quoted phrases in narration enter speaker metrics and can create false mismatch or collapse findings.

findings.evidence: attribute_quotes scans per line with _QUOTE_RE requiring open/close on one line; reproduced multiline quote spanning lines yields no attribution (cited line 39 is VoiceCard import).
findings.message: ghostreader/analyzers/voice_card_detector.py:39 — Multiline dialogue omission. Authors are hurt: quoted speech spanning manuscript lines is not matched, reducing speaker metrics and potentially suppressing findings.

findings.evidence: cli.py gates register/thrash with depth then analyze_*_findings(..., enabled=False) returns []; JSON still emits empty watcher arrays with no disabled marker.
findings.message: ghostreader/cli.py:381-382 — Silent watcher disablement. Analyze users are hurt: when the depth gate is false, JSON still contains empty watcher arrays, indistinguishable from detectors that ran and found nothing.

findings.evidence: clamp_progress_to_disk/_clamp_last permanently min() the saved cursor to max chapter-*.md; pipeline always runs this, so a partial/renamed chapter dir lowers high-water and reprocesses chapters when files return.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/progress.py:20–30 — Disk-based cursor clamp. Users with partial, renamed, or relocated chapter files can have their saved high-water mark lowered, causing completed chapters to be reprocessed when files return.

findings.evidence: compute_order_warnings clamps last via _clamp_last before regression checks, so a partial disk max can hide rewrite warnings against the true saved high-water mark.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/progress.py:130–145 — Cursor clamping can suppress regression warnings. Users pointed at a partial chapter directory may not be warned that an earlier chapter changed relative to their saved high-water mark.

findings.evidence: cards_eligible_for_contrast only casefold+strip; 'Hello!' vs 'Hello' and 'Terse, clipped.' vs 'Terse clipped' remain eligible and can false-trigger card_collapse.
findings.message: ghostreader/analyzers/voice_card_detector.py:119 — Punctuation-only card contrast. Authors are hurt: cards differing only in punctuation are treated as distinct, so speakers with effectively identical cards can receive a false `card_collapse` finding.

findings.evidence: _load_one_card returns None on unreadable/parse failures with only _LOG.debug; load_voice_cards silently continues, and pipeline warns only when the whole set is empty—partial skips hide missed character comparisons.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/voice_cards.py:130-135 — Silent partial card set. Authors are hurt: unreadable or invalid cards are skipped without a user-visible diagnostic, so comparisons involving those characters are missed.
